new: ईमानदार वक्ता विरोधियों को जीत ले; देवों को चाहने वाला देवों को न चाहने वाले पर प्रबल हो। उत्तम सहायक युद्धों में दुर्जय को जीत ले; यजमान यज्ञ न करने वाले के भोग का विभाग कर ले।

old: bahuvrīhi, m. inst. sg. (agreeing with haviṣā)
new: bahuvrīhi, m. nom. sg. (agreeing with yaḥ)
why: reviewer (error): "inst. sg. agreeing with haviṣā" is wrong: an s-stem instrumental would be -manasā; the printed śraddhāmanā is the nom. sg. m. śraddhā-manāḥ (visarga lost before h), agreeing with yaḥ: "who, faithful-minded, honours ... with an oblation". The English "an oblation given in faith" and Hindi "श्रद्धापूर्ण मन से हवि" follow the wrong case.

old: He indeed, with the people, with the clan, by birth, with sons, carries off the prize and wealth with men; he who honours the father of the gods, Brahmaṇaspati, with an oblation given in faith.
new: He indeed, with the people, with the clan, by birth, with sons, carries off the prize and wealth with men; he who, faithful-minded, honours with an oblation the father of the gods, Brahmaṇaspati.
why: reviewer (error): "given in faith" is not in the text; see gram.

old: śraddhāmanā is taken as an instrumental form agreeing loosely with haviṣā ('faithful-minded'); it may instead refer to the worshipper. 'father of the gods' is the text's own apposition.

why: reviewer (minor): The note offers the instrumental reading as primary; revise to say the nominative agreeing with yaḥ is the reading and that the draft's earlier instrumental was rejected.
